name: Amunet, Hidden Breath Goddess
loreTies: Amunet embodies hidden breath, unseen sovereignty, veiled sun power, and secret paths within The Solar Dominion of Khepra.
The Sun-Scale Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Aten Ra culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Amunet, Hidden Breath Goddess, is a playable goddess in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Amunet is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — hidden breath, unseen sovereignty, veiled sun power, and secret paths. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Amunet is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Amunet is the actual goddess recognized by Aten Ra source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their domain — hidden breath, unseen sovereignty, veiled sun power, and secret paths — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Aten Ra, Amunet expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their gameplay role, Assassin, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Amunet can interact with The Sun-Scale Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Amunet understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Amunet enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how hidden breath, unseen sovereignty, veiled sun power, and secret paths survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Amunet, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Aten Ra mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Amunet crosses The Sun-Scale Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
mythicSource: Amunet + hidden sun + concealed names + unseen breath
visualCanon: Assassin deity wrapped in black-gold linen-light veils, concealed solar disc under a shadow crown, obsidian name-blades, lapis void cloak, negative-space sacred forms, and faint hand-rays visible only at edges. Must be elegant and mythic, not ninja, robot assassin, or generic shadow demon.
title: Hidden Breath Goddess

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Amunet is the actual goddess of Aten Ra source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
